scripts.build: yarn workspace @ds.ui/foundation build && yarn workspace @ds.ui/scss build && yarn workspace @ds.ui/react build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n foundation,scss,react,playground "yarn workspace @ds.ui/foundation dev" "yarn workspace @ds.ui/scss dev" "yarn workspace @ds.ui/react dev" "yarn workspace @ds.ui/playground-react dev"
scripts.test: yarn workspace @ds.ui/foundation test && yarn workspace @ds.ui/react test
scripts.storybook: concurrently -n scss,storybook "yarn workspace @ds.ui/scss dev" "yarn workspace @ds.ui/react storybook"
